# Bundled desktop fonts

Vericopy embeds these fonts so the native interface has a stable offline
typographic identity on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

- Source Serif 4 variable: editorial headings and product voice.
- IBM Plex Sans variable: interface text and controls.
- IBM Plex Mono regular: paths, ports, checksums, and technical metadata.

The unmodified font files come from Google Fonts repository snapshot
`389b770410cc0b7c21c85673bfa2077420fe7f65`. Source Serif 4 and IBM Plex are
distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the corresponding license
texts are included in this directory.
